doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Old cornets, Alfred's cornet, Johnny Provenzana
summary: They talk about old silver cornets, Alfred's B-flat cornet, and Johnny Provenzana, who played an E-flat cornet, plus Biloxi musicians.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns
